heading: Want to Improve Your Visual Attention and Cognitive Flexibility?
description: Try these brain games and puzzle activities at home to practise visual scanning, sequencing, planning, and switching between different rules.

products.name: Spot It! (Dobble)
features: Find matching symbols among many visual distractors.
Encourages quick target identification and accurate responses.
Simple to play in short rounds at home.

products.name: ThinkFun Rush Hour
features: Analyze a crowded board and identify possible moves.
Requires planning a sequence of actions.

products.name: Maze Puzzle Book for Adults
features: Trace paths through increasingly complex mazes.
Encourages careful visual tracking and route selection.
An inexpensive, reusable-style alternative to electronic games.
